payload.raid_opened:
The first pass's four entries stand (wrong-lint-becomes-workaround-pressure, lint-that-cannot-decide-parks-a-run, guidance-join-buries-the-instruction, rg-is-a-hard-dependency) plus the eleven carried from i8d. TWO ARE ADDED by the rewalk, and the first is this iteration's new central risk.

se.raid-mandatory-rounds-degrade-into-ceremony (risk, agent) - THE ONE TO WATCH. Four rounds are now required, and a required field can always be satisfied with a paragraph of agreement. A red-team round that restates the case FOR the decision is WORSE than no round: same cost, a record that looks like scrutiny, and a gate that is harder to challenge later because it appears already challenged. Nothing refuses a well-written agreement, so the failure is silent by construction. RULED NOW, from v1's rubric rather than invented: the round must NAME THE KILL-CRITERION and report what was found when it was looked for; a round with no kill-criterion is not a round. Retro tripwire: count gates whose redteam_round changed nothing - if that is all of them, the same agent arguing with itself is not enough and the structural answer is v1's own rule, that the agent never self-certifies a killer.

se.raid-reopen-can-erase-work-by-cone (risk, agent) - reopen re-activates the named states AND their downstream cone, which is correct semantics and a large hammer: this rewalk superseded 30 fills across 46 states in one call. Already mitigated by design, which is why it is a risk and not an issue - fills are SUPERSEDED, never deleted, so a wide reopen costs re-walking and never the record. Fallback if it bites: report the cone size before applying and refuse an unusually wide one without confirmation.

AND ONE CARRIED ENTRY IS NOW SHARPER RATHER THAN NEW: se.raid-items-are-prose-so-the-best-checks-cannot-be-mechanical. The rewalk shows the same disease at a third level. Items are prose, so conformance cannot be linted. Guidance is prose in a state note, so rules do not reach the packet. And the REVIEW ROUNDS were prose in a method note, so the review never happened. Each level was written, none was collected, and the highest level is the one that would have caught the other two.
